content:
maya: Quick ping — I'm opening a PR to refresh the developer onboarding quickstart. Focus: tiny hello app, swap to SDK v5 auth pattern, clearer env var guidance, and a minimal first-deploy path (Docker + GH Actions). Posting draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — please sanity-check the auth section.

liam: Can you repost the PR link? GitHub blocked the preview for me earlier.

maya: Sure — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Major edits in /docs/onboarding/first-touch.md and /examples/hello-min/README.md.

priya: I can review auth. Quick Q: do we prefer the env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY or REDWOOD_KEY? I thought we agreed on REDWOOD_API_KEY in the last pass.

sam: REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also add a short note about token scopes for embeddings vs generation — folks trip over that.

maya: Switched to REDWOOD_API_KEY and added a one-line note about scopes. Also included a small curl + JS snippet for the auth header and a migration blurb for older SDKs. Example uses: `sdk.auth('apiKey')` pattern.

liam: On deploy: the Dockerfile in examples is a bit heavy. Can we provide a 2-step build + run and a GH Action that uses `node:20-buster-slim`? I can push a follow-up commit to slim it down.

maya: Yes please — keep example tiny (<= 30 LOC). I also added a "smoke test" curl command that hits the demo route with Authorization header to confirm the app is responding.

sam: For CI: add an action job that runs the smoke curl against `http://localhost:3000` during the `start` step. Do we pin the image or use `node:20-buster-slim`? I usually recommend pinning for reproducibility but unpinned is simpler for quickstarts.

priya: Auth wording note: call out the OAuth redirect URI for local testing: `http://localhost:3000/callback`. Also mention differences for VPC/private deploys.

maya: Added the redirect URI note and a short paragraph about VPC restrictions. Tagged @nina for any runtime notes about token lifetimes. @buildbot kicked a preview site for the PR: https://deploy-preview-4123.playground.redwood.dev

buildbot: Preview built ✅ — https://deploy-preview-4123.playground.redwood.dev. Build logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/4123/logs

nina: Quick runtime FYI: with SDK v5 please emphasize client reuse across cold starts in serverless. Avoid calling `new Client()` per request if possible. I added a one-liner suggestion.

maya: Added client-reuse snippet: ``const client = global._rwClient || (global._rwClient = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY }));`` and explained why.

liam: I'll push the Docker slimming and GH Action change today and assign the commits to this PR.

priya: I'll finish the auth wording and add a short migration blurb for SDK v4 -> v5 token helpers.

maya: Thanks all. If there are no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning and schedule publish. @docs-bot can you add a changelog entry?

docs-bot: Changelog updated: docs/onboarding/CHANGELOG.md — entry added for PR #4123

maya: Great — putting this on my merge checklist for tomorrow morning. If anyone wants an extra edit, leave a review on the PR. Thanks!
